'''Stephen Lanza''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[2000 Alabama State Championship]] on 29 April 2000, according to Andy McClure's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d642">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-al-states-in-birmingham-4-29-00d642/ al-states-in-birmingham-4-29-00], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 1 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-al-states-in-birmingham-4-29-00d642/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
